runs.summary: Rerun with nothing changed, 2008 comes out as it did: Obama wins, 365–173. The closest state was Missouri, which went to McCain by 0.1 points. Every one of my 100 reruns reproduces it exactly.
howIGotThis: The numbers: the 2000 and 2010 census counts interpolated to 2008 and certified returns; every draw reproduces 2008 exactly before the change.
How sure: I reran it 100 times with different population and parameter draws.
